#   Sekuripy › SSH Bruteforce Attackers
#   
#   This blocklist contains IP addresses identified through SSH authentication
#   logs as sources of brute-force login attempts against exposed services.
#   
#   It is maintained by the same author as the IPSUM blocklist project and is
#   intended to help mitigate repeated SSH password-guessing attacks.
#   
#   IPs in this list are derived from observed authentication failures and
#   malicious login patterns targeting SSH endpoints.
#   
#   This third-party blocklist is not maintained by ConfigServer; IPs are
#   sourced externally and not curated by us. We do however, validate the
#   blocklist to ensure that it only contains properly validated IP addresses,
#   and does not include any non-relevant or malformed data beyond the scope
#   of the source.
#   
#   Use at the administrator’s discretion based on risk tolerance and
#   environment requirements.
